note: abap2ui5-linter baseline: findings that existed when the linter was adopted. Suppressed on every run; NEW findings still fail, a STALE entry fails too. Regenerate with --update-baseline. Down from 86 to 33. What went was answered in the SOURCE or in the config, never by moving it here: defects fixed (a navigation on an event parameter that does not exist, a selection bound to a field the row type has not got, two icon-only buttons with no accessible name, a hand-rolled init flag, ten PUBLIC attributes shipped on every roundtrip for nothing), deliberate demonstrations given a directive that says what they demonstrate, five view chains rewritten one element per line, nine lifecycle IF blocks made into IF/ELSEIF chains, and src/00/98 - the TEST package - excluded from non-released-api in the config, where the reason is readable, instead of fourteen silent rows here. Of the 33 left, 31 are findings the pinned linter 0.1.1 produces and @abap2ui5/linter 0.2.0 does not: a nested or INCLUDE-built structure, a type owned by another class, a model a template:repeat declares, a WHEN OTHERS dispatcher, a branch that delegates its view_display, a button labelled by a COND, and an `else` inside a MessageStrip's prose ending an IF branch. They go stale with the pin bump - and a stale entry FAILS, so the bump clears them rather than a person remembering to. The two that remain after that are real and deliberate: app 449 feeds the PDFViewer a sample PDF hosted only on the SAPUI5 demo kit (no OpenUI5 equivalent could be confirmed), and app 448's whole subject is driving a property through control_by_id.
